page.content:
Clades, formations, and discoveries that keep rewriting deep-time life.

How Dinosaurs connects

  • Topic: Dinosauria — Dinosauria is the formal clade behind the public subject of dinosaurs.
  • Character: Mary Anning — Anning's Jurassic Coast trade trained the paleontology that later framed dinosaurs.

What is Dinosaurs?

Dinosaurs are the Mesozoic archosaurs whose fossils, from Morrison sauropods to Hell Creek tyrannosaurs, still reorganize family trees. Living birds are their surviving lineage; the rest ended at the K–Pg extinction.

Key threads lead to Dinosauria and Mary Anning.
